advisory.headline: Moderate rain is possible in the next day or two. Plan field work around the rain window and avoid spraying close to rainfall.
points: Check local IMD updates for your district before major field decisions.
Keep drainage channels clear before heavy rain spells.
Protect harvested produce and inputs from unexpected rain.
advisory.irrigation: Rain is expected soon — skip or reduce irrigation today and check soil moisture again after the rain.
advisory.spraying: Rain or wind is likely — avoid spraying today; sprays wash off or drift.
